summary: Follow tokens to experts and back while exposing load imbalance, capacity limits and permutation correctness.
outcomes: Trace token routing, packing, expert execution and return permutation.
Explain imbalance and communication costs under different routing distributions.
sequence: Route a tiny batch to two experts with labeled token IDs.
Pack tokens for destinations and execute all-to-all.
Run expert computations and invert the permutation.
Expose capacity overflow, skew and dropped-token policies.
Measure useful expert work and communication on a bounded case.

visual.question: Does each token return to the correct position after remote computation?
visual.interaction: Change routing assignments and inspect imbalance and inverse mapping.

practice.task: Trace or implement a two-expert routing test with skewed assignments.
practice.success: Tokens are neither lost nor duplicated outside a documented policy; reference outputs match.
